## Why This Is Asked

- Auto scaling per variant
- Canary/shadow testing and rollback criteria

## Code Example

```python
import boto3
client = boto3.client('sagemaker')

response = client.create_endpoint_config(
  EndpointConfigName='TextClassifierShadowConfig',
  ProductionVariants=[
    {'VariantName':'v1','ModelName':'TextModelV1','InitialInstanceCount':1,'InstanceType':'ml.m5.xlarge','InitialVariantWeight':0.9},
    {'VariantName':'v2','ModelName':'TextModelV2','InitialInstanceCount':1,'InstanceType':'ml.m5.xlarge','InitialVariantWeight':0.1}
  ]
)
```
